question: would i get rate limited sending fifty requests a second on the free plan

packet.utterance: would i get rate limited sending fifty requests a second on the free plan

facts: yes: the Free plan allows 20 requests per second (burst 40), so 50 a second gets 429 Too Many Requests
at 50 a second you'd also use up Free's 10,000 daily requests in about 3½ minutes (200 seconds)
Starter (60/s, 250,000 a day) is the lowest plan that covers 50 a second
